name: How does hurricane season impact boaters and waterfront property owners in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: How does hurricane season impact boaters and waterfront property owners in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hurricane season, typically from June 1st to November 30th, significantly impacts boaters and waterfront property owners. Owners must have a hurricane plan for their vessel, which may involve securing it in a designated hurricane-rated marina, hauling it out of the water, or moving it inland. For waterfront homeowners, securing outdoor items and understanding flood zones is crucial. This is a process clarity issue: proactive preparation before hurricane season starts can minimize risks and ensure compliance with local emergency plans. Kelby Contreras emphasizes the importance of understanding these preparations when considering a waterfront investment.
